title: auto-rerun label: create the repository label with its exact description before any workflow or dependabot.yml applies it
answers: Why does the bot PR step fail or skip labeling with auto-rerun?
Where is the auto-rerun label defined and what should its description say?
How do I add a new automation that opts PRs into CI retries?
body:
Path: .github/dependabot.yml (Dependabot `labels`), .github/workflows/uv.yml and .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml (`gh pr create --label` and `gh pr edit --add-label`) apply `auto-rerun`; .github/workflows/retry.yml searches on it. The label is a repository label, not created by these files.
Rule: Create the `auto-rerun` label in the repo before merging any change that applies it, using the description `Automatically rerun eligible failed CI runs (up to 3 retries).`. Labels referenced in the workflows are only applied if they already exist.
Constraints: This note covers the label's prerequisite only; it does not change the retry selection logic. If the label is missing, the retry sweep finds no candidates for those PRs. Check the label exists before debugging retry eligibility.
applies: Any workflow or Dependabot config in this repo that adds or searches the auto-rerun label.
says: Automated dependency pull requests fail continuous integration checks without retrying failed tests.
Automatically retry failed build runs on automated model catalog pull requests.
The automatic rerun tag is missing from newly opened bot pull requests.
Enable automated test retries for pull requests created by repository bots.
Scheduled retry sweeps skip failing pull requests instead of re-running tests.
search: Repository workflows and Dependabot configurations using the `auto-rerun` label require the label to exist beforehand with the description `Automatically rerun eligible failed CI runs (up to 3 retries).`. The label is referenced in `.github/dependabot.yml`, `.github/workflows/uv.yml`, and `.github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml`, while `.github/workflows/retry.yml` searches on it. This guidance covers the prerequisite label creation only, without modifying the retry selection logic.
